answer_1.quote: We evaluate the performance of different calibration datasets, we first prune the dense LLM with certain calibration data and then evaluate the resulting sparse LLM on all the downstream tasks considered using few-shot prompting.

answer_2.quote: We report the results of our experiments... using accuracy across nine downstream tasks... We also varied the calibration data lengths and evaluated the perplexity of Llama 2-Chat 7B pruned to 50% unstructured sparsity.
